The benchmark evaluates requirement-element classification, not end-to-end physical-system verification.
The additional fields functional, OnlyF, OnlyQ, and Q are excluded because the supplied eTour automatic
file is degenerate for those fields (all-zero outputs); treating them as ordinary predictions would inflate
disagreement counts and misstate the classifier output.
